import csv, io
def t(s):
    try:
        rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(s, newline=''), strict=True))
        print(repr(s), '->', rows)
    except csv.Error as e:
        print(repr(s), '-> ERROR:', e)
t('a,"b"c,d\n')
t('a,"b\nc,d\n')
